<\STATESEP>theory GenFilterSystem
imports UserFilter
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym component = "(channel, component_state) comp"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym lstate = "component_state local_state"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym gstate = "(inst, channel, component_state) global_state"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  Store_untrusted :: "(Store_channel \<Rightarrow> channel) \<Rightarrow> component"
where
  "Store_untrusted ch \<equiv>
    LOOP (
      UserStep
    \<squnion> ArbitraryRequest (ch Store_l)
    \<squnion> ArbitraryResponse (ch Store_l))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  Client_untrusted :: "(Client_channel \<Rightarrow> channel) \<Rightarrow> component"
where
  "Client_untrusted ch \<equiv>
    LOOP (
      UserStep
    \<squnion> ArbitraryRequest (ch Client_l)
    \<squnion> ArbitraryResponse (ch Client_l))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  Filter_untrusted :: "(Filter_channel \<Rightarrow> channel) \<Rightarrow> component"
where
  "Filter_untrusted ch \<equiv>
    LOOP (
      UserStep
    \<squnion> ArbitraryRequest (ch Filter_external)
    \<squnion> ArbitraryResponse (ch Filter_external)
    \<squnion> ArbitraryRequest (ch Filter_backing)
    \<squnion> ArbitraryResponse (ch Filter_backing))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  store_untrusted :: component
where
  "store_untrusted \<equiv> Store_untrusted (\<lambda>c. case c of Store_l \<Rightarrow> two)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  client_untrusted :: component
where
  "client_untrusted \<equiv> Client_untrusted (\<lambda>c. case c of Client_l \<Rightarrow> one)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  filter_untrusted :: component
where
  "filter_untrusted \<equiv>
    Filter_untrusted (\<lambda>c. case c of Filter_backing \<Rightarrow> two
                                  | Filter_external \<Rightarrow> one)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  gs\<^sub>0 :: gstate
where
  "gs\<^sub>0 p \<equiv> case trusted p of Some s \<Rightarrow> Some s
    | _ \<Rightarrow> (case p of store \<Rightarrow> Some (store_untrusted, Component init_component_state)
                    | client \<Rightarrow> Some (client_untrusted, Component init_component_state)
                    | filter \<Rightarrow> Some (filter_untrusted, Component init_component_state))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
